proof_0265.moves: Pure wrapper: unwrap the DTreeMap to its internal Impl via `inner`, feed in the stored well-formedness proof, and apply the corresponding Impl-level lemma. No mathematical content beyond the delegation.

proof_0266.moves: The underlying set of the infimum of two opens is the intersection of their underlying sets; this holds by definition of the complete-lattice structure on Opens, so the proof is `rfl`. The content is a definitional unfolding, not a citation.

proof_0267.moves: HashSet is a HashMap with Unit values, so the statement unwraps via `inner` and is exactly the HashMap getKey! lemma about unions when the key is absent from the left map. Pure delegation.

proof_0268.moves: Build the factorization instance: for each morphism, pull the existence theorem giving a factorization through P_sigma then P_delta, destructure the existential witnesses (object, two maps, equation, orienting the equation as needed), and repackage them as MapFactorizationData wrapped in Nonempty inside HasFactorization. The real work is the existence lemma plus witness destructuring/repackaging.

proof_0269.moves: Given that (f x, g x) tends to the uniformity filter, convergence of f to a and of g to a are equivalent. Prove both directions with the congr_uniformity transfer lemma, using symmetry of the uniformity hypothesis for the reverse direction; the two-directional Iff.intro assembly is the shape of the proof.

proof_0270.moves: Eventually along atTop every x exceeds the fixed a (no top element), and anything strictly greater than a is different from a. So: take eventually_gt_atTop and weaken it pointwise with ne_of_gt via Eventually.mono.

proof_0271.moves: Specialize the general 'f commutes with Finset.sup' lemma to a linear order: the only hypothesis needed is that a monotone map on a linear order preserves binary sups, which is Monotone.map_sup. Everything else is supplying the lattice structure a linear order carries.

proof_0272.moves: Finsets of a fintype form a Boolean algebra, so the subset/complement swap is the purely order-theoretic fact le_compl_iff_le_compl transported to that instance. The idea is 'this is just Heyting/Boolean complement duality'.

proof_0273.moves: The underlying coalgebra hom of a composite coalgebra equivalence is the composite of the underlying homs; this is true by how CoalgEquiv.trans is defined, so the proof is `rfl`. Definitional, no citation carries the content.

proof_0274.moves: A presented group is by definition the quotient of a free group by the normal closure of the relations, so the canonical map is a quotient-group projection and surjectivity is immediate from QuotientGroup.mk_surjective.

proof_0275.moves: Finset.sup is a fold of the binary sup starting at bottom; since sup is idempotent (and commutative/associative), inserting an element just joins its value on, which is exactly fold_insert_idem.

proof_0276.moves: The topology PUnit carries is literally the bottom (discrete) topology by definition, so constructing the DiscreteTopology instance amounts to supplying `rfl` for its single field.

proof_0277.moves: HashMap is a thin wrapper over DHashMap with constant value type, so the statement unwraps via `inner` and is the DHashMap.Const get! lemma for unions when the key is absent from the right map. Pure delegation.

proof_0278.moves: The stated characterization is exactly the definition of LowerHemicontinuousOn unfolded, so the proof is Iff.rfl. The content is definitional unfolding, which no citation names.

proof_0279.moves: If a finite product is nonzero at x, then no factor can vanish at x, since a single vanishing factor forces the whole product to be zero (Finset.prod_eq_zero). Contrapositive plus the membership characterization of a doubly-indexed intersection gives the support inclusion.

proof_0280.moves: Pi.single is Function.update applied to the zero function, so the image of the interval under single is the already-proved image-under-update statement specialized at 0. Pure specialization.

proof_0281.moves: To test retrocompactness of s ∩ t against an open set u, reassociate (s ∩ t) ∩ u = s ∩ (t ∩ u); t ∩ u is open since both are, so retrocompactness of t makes it compact and retrocompactness of s then makes s ∩ (t ∩ u) compact. The load-bearing step is the associativity rewrite plus two applications of the definition.

proof_0282.moves: Take a point of the image, destructure it as f x for some x in the source set, then split on whether x lies in the relevant part: in the good case apply_mem places f x in the target, in the bad case apply_of_notMem pins down its value. The proof is a witness destructuring plus a case split feeding two lemmas.

proof_0283.moves: A perfect number is in particular pseudoperfect (it is the sum of a subset of its proper divisors), and primes are not pseudoperfect since their only proper divisor is 1. Chain the two facts.

proof_0284.moves: ExtHashMap wraps ExtDHashMap with a constant value type, so unwrapping via `inner` reduces the emptiness-of-intersection statement to the already-proved dependent version. Pure delegation.

proof_0285.moves: The primitive character attached to any Dirichlet character (here, to the product of two characters at the lcm of their moduli) is primitive, which is exactly the general primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive lemma applied to the product.

proof_0286.moves: Unwrap the bundled DHashMap to its raw representation as a Subtype (raw data together with the buckets-size-positive proof), supply the stored well-formedness proof, and apply the Raw₀-level get = getD lemma. Delegation plus repackaging of the invariant.

proof_0287.moves: A HashMap built with a given capacity is empty, so nothing is a member; the statement is the DHashMap version verbatim after unwrapping. Pure delegation.

proof_0288.moves: In the sum order no inl element is above an inr element, and the LocallyFiniteOrder instance on a sum is defined by cases so that this mixed open interval is literally the empty Finset. Proof is `rfl` — the content is that the instance computes definitionally.
